gizmo.title: Iphazili yamagama
gizmo.description: Iphazili yamagama eyenziwe ngoluhlu lwamagama nezikhokelo. Igridi yenzelwa wena; abafundi bachwetheza amagama baze bawajonge.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko okanye umbuzo oboniswa ngaphezulu kwephazili.

configure.title: Amagama
configure.description: Igama ngalinye nesikhokelo salo. Igridi yenziwa ngolu luhlu: elona gama lide libekwa kuqala kwaye amanye aliwela koonobumba ekwabelwana ngabo.

advanced.title: Umbala wogxininiso
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa wetshiphu yesihloko, igama elisebenzayo namaqhosha esenzo.

advanced.title: Iyasongeka
advanced.description: Bonisa le phazili njengomqolo ovulekayo novalekayo. Ukuvula omnye kuvala eminye imibuzo esongekayo ecaleni kwawo.

advanced.title: Qala usongiwe
advanced.description: Xa isongeka, qala njengomqolo ovaliweyo obonisa isihloko nesimo saso kuphela.

advanced.title: Ifomathi yokumaka
advanced.description: OER Schema: ifomathi yokumaka yolu vavanyo (umz. amanqaku, unobumba, ipesenti, ukugqitywa).

advanced.title: Injongo yokufunda
advanced.description: OER Schema: injongo yokufunda enxulumene nolu vavanyo.

developer.title: Igama lovavanyo
developer.description: Igama lovavanyo elisetyenziselwa ukuchonga kwe-xAPI kwiinkqubo zohlalutyo.

developer.title: Ikhosi
developer.description: OER Schema: ikhosi olu vavanyo lwenzelwe yona.
